title: Cute Toddler Girl in Walker Stroller, 1955 Vintage B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white square snapshot photo stamped August 1955 showing a curly-haired toddler girl standing up inside a metal wire baby stroller walker on a grassy lawn. Parked along the curb directly behind her is a classic mid-1950s automobile featuring whitewall tires and chrome hubcaps, with suburban apartment buildings in the background.
